items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did things for Gigi Gryce and Benny Golson too: Social Call and I Remember Clifford.

ctx.x: All of those guys, you wrote lyrics to their music. Little Niles. Hi-Fly. Doodlin’, which is one of my all-time favorites. Gosh. Who else was there?
I did things for Gigi Gryce and Benny Golson too: Social Call and I Remember Clifford. Stablemates and all those things.
Let’s see. I’m trying to think of the name of this other song. Whisper Not.
